name: Chambers Bay
architects: Robert Trent Jones Jr., with Bruce Charlton (on site) and Jay Blasi (project architect), 2007 (thefriedegg.com)

dtm.source: USGS 3DEP 1 m DEM, project WA_PierceCounty_2020_A20 (2020 Lidar: Pierce County, WA, flown 10 Apr - 4 Jun 2020), tile x53y523 (published 2021-06-13), clipped to the world + 100 m by pipeline/clip_raster.py (release.json); EPSG:26910 (NAD83 / UTM 10N), NAVD88 metres; downloaded by the developer 2026-10-20 (GitHub release chambers-bay-data)

laz.source: 2020 Lidar: Pierce County, WA (NOAA Data Access Viewer dataset 9343, job J1472993), flown from 10 April 2020 (GPS times; project 10 Apr - 4 Jun 2020); NAD83(2011) / Washington South (EPSG:6598, metres), NAVD88 US survey feet; clipped to the world + 100 m by data/chambers_bay/make_laz.py; class 1 (unclassified: vegetation and structures; the project has no vegetation classes); ordered by the developer 2026-10-20 (GitHub release chambers-bay-data)
laz.label: 2020 USGS lidar

world.note: OSM course boundary bbox (917 x 1,301 m, UTM 10N) + scenery, rounded out to whole 256 m chunks and centred: 1,280 m east-west (182 m each side), 1,792 m north-south (246 m each side)

scorecard_source: Club scorecard PDF (Golf ScoreCards Inc., 10/2025, Chambers-Bay-Scorecard-10-2.pdf, supplied by the developer in the release chambers-bay-data, 2026-10-20). Every tee row adds up to its printed total. Built from the Blue tees only (COURSE_BUILD 4.1 default).
attribution: Elevation and trees: U.S. Geological Survey 3D Elevation Program (2020 Pierce County, WA lidar)
Imagery for tee placement: USDA National Agriculture Imagery Program
Scorecard: Chambers Bay club card (Golf ScoreCards Inc., 10/2025)
notes: Phase 1 decisions (developer, 2026-10-20): Blue tees only; all water red (none mapped on the course); OB = the OSM boundary (BNSF railway, beach and Puget Sound outside it); trails and cart paths inside give free relief; the wetland inside the boundary (w582088908) stays woods, as the pipeline draws it; new theme 'puget' (the developer: coastal would be slightly off); wind 'pumped up a bit' to the open-coast 3-14 mph; the card and title images may be committed. First built without the lidar (developer 2026-10-20, option a); rebuilt with it the same day once the NOAA job arrived.

drop_trees.reason: course chat 2026-10-20: not a tree - a single 6.9 m lidar spike (crown radius 1.1 m) on the cart path left of hole 7's fairway; the NAIP photo shows no tree there (a pole or sign)
course chat 2026-10-20: not a tree - the roof of the halfway house by the 1st tee (8.2 m), which OSM doesn't map as a building
